And in more detail>

1. Download the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url] 
2. In the 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits  mod files go to assets>portraits 
3.Replace "Sebastian" folder  
4. Move Beach Sebastian to the "beach" folder.
5. Open folder “Festivals” > Replace Flower dance Sebastian to folder FlowerDance > Replace SpiritsEve Sebastian to folder SpiritEve
6.  DONE :D

Also this is not seasonal version: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14159?tab=posts]﻿Socially awkward and tired Sebastian (perfect for Possessed Sebastian mod)[/url]
